items.question: What exactly do you do?
items.answer: A web agency for small businesses: professional landing page, weekly content, and social media publishing. Everything connected, no complications.

items.question: What does each plan include?
items.answer: CUSTOM: a custom landing (Basic/Pro/Premium). WEEKLY: 3, 5, or 7 pieces per week depending on the tier. SOCIAL: managed publishing on Facebook and Instagram. FULL: Custom Pro + Weekly Pro + Social Pro integrated for €199/mo, with the website setup included.

items.question: Am I locked into a contract?
items.answer: No. No lock-in. Switch tiers or cancel whenever you want: downgrades apply next cycle, upgrades are prorated.

items.question: Which social networks do you manage?
items.answer: Facebook and Instagram. For additional networks, ask us: they are not included by default.

items.question: Do you reply to my DMs or comments?
items.answer: No. We don't reply to comments or private messages on any plan. Replying in the business's name means checking every post daily: that's community management, with its own time and price.

items.question: Do you run ads?
items.answer: Not included in the plans. We can advise you, but we don't manage paid campaigns.

items.question: Do you shoot photos or produce video?
items.answer: Not included. The SOCIAL PREMIUM Reel is made by reusing your own content from the same month (10–15 s).

items.question: What happens to my landing if I cancel?
items.answer: The landing and its content are yours: once invoiced and published, the usage rights belong to the client. When you cancel, we stop producing and publishing new content.

items.question: What are the delivery times?
items.answer: Landing: 48–72 h (Basic), 5–7 days (Pro), and 7–10 days (Premium) after design approval. Weekly content: 48 h before publishing.
